title: Design staged disaster recovery exercises: decision comparison 2
teachingQuestion: Given a recovery claim, which test form can produce the needed evidence without exceeding the authorized disruption?
focalInsight: Form selection, production impact, evidence, stop authority, and exercise-status communication.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Exercise Safety Boundary
nodes.definition: Predefined constraints, stop conditions, escalation path, and rollback limits that keep an exercise from causing unacceptable harm.
nodes.decision: Set a named stop authority and measurable halt criteria before live actions begin.
nodes.failureExample: If no one can stop an unsafe failover, a test can become the outage it was meant to prepare for.
nodes.detail: Predefined constraints, stop conditions, escalation path, and rollback limits that keep an exercise from causing unacceptable harm.

nodes.label: Exercise Communication
nodes.definition: Controlled messages that identify the activity as a test, identify channels and approvals, and distinguish exercise signals from a real incident.
nodes.decision: Notify the affected roles before and during the exercise, while preserving an unmistakable path for genuine incident escalation.
nodes.failureExample: An unlabeled alarm during a test can trigger unnecessary external escalation or cause a real alert to be dismissed.
nodes.detail: Controlled messages that identify the activity as a test, identify channels and approvals, and distinguish exercise signals from a real incident.

learningContract.misconception: A tabletop proves that recovery systems work, and a completed exercise is automatically a pass.
learningContract.formRationale: Aligned columns make concept meanings, decision criteria and failure consequences explicit and comparable.
learningContract.focalInsight: Form selection, production impact, evidence, stop authority, and exercise-status communication.
learningContract.intentionalOmissions: Do not assign universal test frequency, RTO/RPO, or regulatory notification triggers.
learningContract.retrievalPrompt: A hospital must prove its alternate site can process real work while production continues. Which form, evidence, and safety boundary fit?
